owner_decision: 09/23/2026: the owner asked for the PDF path to be built. Only the documents below, and PDFs under a listed path, are read as text; every figure still passes the same evidence checks as HTML, and a figure quoted from a flattened table row is held for human review. The owner approved merging it on 09/23/2026; the starting list is the maintainer’s proposal from the 09/22 gap fill, and the owner may add or remove documents. TSMC’s transcripts were left out: investor.tsmc.com refused 2 of 3 requests (HTTP 403) on 09/23/2026, and the runner does not work around access controls. This does not change the grid-operators.json decision that no PDF number is hand-entered: these are model extractions under review.

documents.why: ERCOT board update: large-load interconnection queue and data-center share.
ERCOT Constraints and Needs report: large-load queue, approved-to-energize MW, TSP vs studied 2031 peak.
PJM Load Analysis Subcommittee large-load summary: data-center growth PJM plans for 2025-2030.
PJM 2026 Load Forecast Report: RTO summer peak path to 2036 and 2046.
SPP 2025 Integrated Transmission Plan: peak-load headline and its figure path.
MISO long-term load forecast whitepaper: coincident peak and data-center energy.

Load Analysis Subcommittee meeting folders by year (las/2026/..., las/2027/...), where PJM posts its large-load adjustment summaries; postings/ templates are outside the prefix.
